build_motor_model: build a python module to instantiate a MotorModel with position control and default PD gains
create_torque_control: create a MotorModel with torque control enabled to convert PWM signals directly to torque
test_convert_to_torque: test the MotorModel convert_to_torque method with a desired angle and current motor state
refactor_viscous_damping: refactor the MotorModel to use a custom viscous damping value via set_viscous_damping
review_pwm_to_torque: review the MotorModel _convert_to_torque_from_pwm method that applies voltage clipping and current-torque saturation
